license: Open Data Commons Open Database License

columns.name: Year
columns.description: The calendar year during which the prevailing wage work was performed.

columns.name: Quarter
columns.description: The quarter of the reporting year (Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4) during which the prevailing wage work was performed.

columns.name: Project County
columns.description: The Illinois county where the public works project is located. Used to identify regional trends in prevailing wage activity.

columns.name: Project Number
columns.description: The project name or number as reported by the contractor. This number is used for tracking and referencing project-specific wage and employment data.

columns.name: Company Name
columns.description: The name of the contractor reporting prevailing wage information for the project.

columns.name: Trade
columns.description: The prevailing wage trade title under which work was performed.

columns.name: Total Employees
columns.description: The number of employees the company reported working on the project during the specified quarter.

columns.name: Percent of Hispanic or Latino Employees
columns.description: Percentage of Hispanic or Latino/a/ex employees the company reported working on the project during the specified quarter.

columns.name: Percent of Non-Hispanic or Latino/a/ex employees
columns.description: Percentage of Non-Hispanic or Latino/a/ex employees the company reported working on the project during the specified quarter.

columns.name: Total Hours
columns.description: The total number of hours worked under the specified trade for the contractor on the project during the quarter.

columns.name: Percent of Hispanic or Latino/a/ex hours
columns.description: Percentage of hours which were completed by Hispanic or Latino/a/ex employees.

columns.name: Percent of Non-Hispanic or Latino/a/ex hours
columns.description: Percentage of hours which were completed by Non-Hispanic or Latino/a/ex employees.
